title: PR/VIT corrected-pipeline cutover readiness

allowed_next_programme_scope: P0 assurance-plane separation / immutable typed assurance generation
immutable VIT lineage/admission record with PR-body pointer only
dual-read shadow comparison and staged cutover preparation
still_reserved: actual required-check/ruleset change unless explicitly included in approved remediation packet
first switch of live admission verifier

tests_qa.wp6_perturbations: 10/10 PASS; 0 unsafe divergence; 0 lost causal receipts
tests_qa.repository_wide_live_ci: NOT_RUN_BY_AUDIT_BY_DESIGN; audit did not target main/live route

key_findings: Pipeline is authority-safe but structurally over-coupled.
AA0/PIP assurance is ordered behind VIT placement in live tests.yml, causing root-cause masking.
Mutable PR prose currently carries decision-bearing VIT lineage.
SIQ check-name/latest-run selection lacks one immutable admission evidence generation.
Placement-only invalidation semantics exist but are not fully actuated end-to-end.
Closeout and stacked branch transport create avoidable base-sensitive churn.
External GitHub API failures can interfere with normative Git ancestry proof.
The corrected shadow model removes these failure amplifiers without reducing fail-closed authority.
warnings: Three historical cases lack exact workflow-job subdetail and remain explicitly NOT_EVALUABLE at that subfield; no hidden inference was used.
Live dual-read/cutover can expose undocumented consumers and therefore requires staged shadow equivalence before switching authority.
The 20-PR cohort is intentionally bounded to the incident window and does not claim universal historical coverage.
rollback: The audit itself requires no live rollback because no live integration surface changed. A future remediation programme must keep current admission authoritative through dual-read shadow, define exact pre-switch rollback, and preserve every new immutable evidence generation.
exact_work_after_pass: Create a separate bounded PR/VIT live remediation conformance programme from latest lawful main. Implement P0 assurance separation and immutable admission generation first in dual-read/shadow mode; run the same 10 regressions and 20-case replay plus live-shadow equivalence; then present a separate switch/cutover gate before changing the live required admission path.
